::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[How to include graphs in my document?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5427/how-to-include-graphs-in-my-document), asked by [Patrick Beardmore](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1746/patrick-beardmore) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-15; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I've just started using LyX for my Economics essays. Using Inkscape, I have been able to create some very neat diagrams to go with them.
>
> However I really need to be able to insert graphs (XY charts, bar charts, histograms etc.) into the document, preferably without having to go via excel. I don't need anything fancy, just something that works with LyX.
:::

[pgfplots](http://pgfplots.sourceforge.net/) is phenomenal.  It's also totally TeX based so you can import your data and plot in one fell swoop.  The package author is very active and the syntax is very tikz-y, so it's easy to learn.
